expectations.text: 交付物正文为中文（EN→ZH 方向），英文仅出现在术语对照表源语列或引用原文处，标题/说明/待确认清单均为中文
expectations.evidence: Deliverable body, tables, and review checklist are in Chinese; English appears only in the source terminology column and quoted text.

expectations.text: Moulded-Case Circuit-Breaker 译为「塑壳断路器」，未直译为「模制外壳断路器」或「塑料外壳断路器」
expectations.evidence: Deliverable heading L9 renders Moulded-Case Circuit-Breaker as "塑料外壳式断路器" (and L37 sets "塑料外壳式断路器" as the primary translation, demoting "塑壳断路器" to a secondary abbreviation column) instead of landing directly on "塑壳断路器".

expectations.text: Rated impulse withstand voltage 译为「额定冲击耐受电压」（用「冲击」不用「脉冲」）
expectations.evidence: Table L14: "额定冲击耐受电压 | U_imp | 8 kV".

expectations.text: Rated service short-circuit breaking capacity 中的 service 译为「运行」（额定运行短路分断能力），不译「服务」
expectations.evidence: Table L20: "额定运行短路分断能力 | I_cs | 36 kA（有效值，AC 415 V，100% I_cu）".

expectations.text: Selectivity category 译为「选择性类别」（不误译为「使用类别」或「区分/歧视类别」），且准确译出 Icu1（相间对中性线交流电压下极极限短路分断能力 / 单极极限短路分断能力）并保留 Icu1 符号
expectations.evidence: Table L22: "选择性类别 | — | A 类"; Table L19: "交流相-中性线电压下额定单极极限短路分断能力 | I_cu1 | 18 kA（有效值）".

expectations.text: 单位符号保留原文 kA rms / kA peak / V AC，未改写成「有效值」「峰值」「交流」
expectations.evidence: Table L13, L15, L18-21 rewrite units into Chinese words ("AC 800 V", "36 kA（有效值，AC 415 V）", "18 kA（有效值）", "72 kA（峰值）") instead of preserving "V AC", "kA rms", "kA peak".

expectations.text: 所有数值照抄未换算（800 V、8 kV、250 A、36 kA rms、18 kA rms、72 kA peak、20,000、8,000）
expectations.evidence: Table L13-27 preserve 800 V, 8 kV, 415 V, 250 A, 36 kA, 18 kA, 72 kA, 20,000, 8,000 unchanged.

expectations.text: 指出源文内部矛盾：选择性类别 A 与给出 Isd（2～10 × Ir）短延时整定不能同时成立，且未擅自删除或改写参数
expectations.evidence: Preserves both A 类 and Isd in table and flags the contradiction under Issue 1 (L64-68: "选择性类别 A 类与 I_sd 整定参数直接冲突").

expectations.text: 未补造源文缺失的 Icw 数值，并在待确认清单中明确指出 Icw 缺失
expectations.evidence: No fabricated Icw value in table; L65 & L68 explicitly note Icw is undeclared and must be supplied if Category B.

expectations.text: 中文正文使用全角标点，参数符号/数值/单位内保持半角且数值与单位之间有单个半角空格
expectations.evidence: Chinese prose uses full-width punctuation; numbers and units use half-width characters with single spaces (8 kV, 250 A, 36 kA, 18 kA, 72 kA).
